verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents output aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), resolution settings (1080p or higher), or native export presets. The multi-platform posting command (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) is a distribution feature. It does not show that the product renders channel-specific formats without external re-encoding.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
